text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Casino Control (Designated Second Site) Order 2012 and shall be deemed to have come into operation on 1st March 2007.

2. All those parcels of land along the northern coast of Sentosa, bounded by Sentosa Gateway, Artillery Avenue and Siloso Road at Sentosa, as shown delineated and marked on the Land Parcel Plan in the Schedule, comprised in Lot numbers 459M, 581C, 424N, 554P, 2740T, 2741A, 2742K, 2743N, 2744X, 2745L, 2746C, 2771T, 2772A, 2773K, 2774N, 2775X, 2776L, 2777C, 2779W, 2787K, 2788N, 2791N, 2793L, 2794C, 2797V and 2798P in Mukim No. 34, shall be designated the Sentosa site on which a casino may be located for a period of 30 years commencing on 1st March 2007.
3. The Casino Control (Designated Second Site) Order 2009 (G.N. No. S 29/2009) is revoked.
